note: Curated starting XIs. Players are listed row by row, starting with the goalkeeper, then each outfield row from left to right as seen by a viewer with the team attacking up the screen. 'formation' must sum to 10 (outfield players). 'accepts' lists extra accepted spellings/nicknames; full names and surnames are accepted automatically.

lineups.blurb: Roy Keane and Paul Scholes were both suspended, so Beckham played centrally. Sheringham and Solskjaer came off the bench to score in injury time.
Three down at half-time. Hamann replaced Finnan at the break and Liverpool scored three in six minutes.
Widely rated one of the great club performances. Mascherano, a midfielder, played centre-back.
Iniesta scored in the 116th minute for Spain's first World Cup.
Ronaldo scored both goals to finish as the tournament's top scorer, three years after a career-threatening knee injury.
Leboeuf deputised for the suspended Laurent Blanc. Zidane headed in two corners.
Arsenal's signature XI from the only 38-game unbeaten league season in English top-flight history. Not a single match lineup - this is the side's most familiar first choice.
5000-1 outsiders at the start of the season. This XI started the majority of the campaign almost unchanged.
Terry, Ivanovic, Ramires and Meireles were all suspended, which is how Ryan Bertrand came to make his Champions League debut in the final.
City's treble-sealing night. Rodri scored; Stones stepped into midfield from the back four in possession. De Bruyne went off injured in the first half.
La Decima. Ramos equalised in the 93rd minute and Madrid scored three in extra time. Xabi Alonso missed the final through suspension.
Messi scored twice, Mbappe hit a hat-trick, and Emiliano Martinez saved the day in the shootout.
Hurst's hat-trick, and the only World Cup won by England. Two Charltons in the same side - you'll need first names for those.
Salah scored a second-minute penalty and Origi came off the bench to seal it.
Ronaldo headed United in front and then missed in the shootout, before Terry slipped and Anelka's penalty was saved.
Coman, a product of the PSG academy, scored the only goal to complete Bayern's treble in an empty stadium.
Gotze scored the winner off the bench in the 113th minute, six days after the 7-1 against Brazil.
Materazzi equalised and was then headbutted by Zidane. Grosso scored the winning penalty.
Guardiola's first treble. With Abidal and Alves suspended and Marquez injured, Puyol played right-back and Yaya Toure filled in at centre-back. Messi headed the second.
Often called the greatest team ever assembled. Carlos Alberto finished off the famous team goal for 4-1.
Revenge for Istanbul two years earlier. Inzaghi scored both, the first off his shoulder from a Pirlo free-kick.
A third European Cup in a row. Bale came off the bench to score an overhead kick, and Karius had a night to forget.
Tuchel's side won it with a Havertz goal after Mount split the City defence.
Mourinho's treble. Milito scored both and left for Real Madrid days later.
A second treble in six years, with Messi, Suárez and Neymar all scoring across the campaign.
The first all-German final. Robben scored the winner in the 89th minute, a year after losing the final at home.
Mourinho's first European Cup, and his last match at the club before joining Chelsea.
An extraordinarily young side. Kluivert, 18, came off the bench to score the winner.
The first English club to win the European Cup, ten years after the Munich air disaster.
A fourteenth European Cup. Courtois made nine saves and Vinícius scored the only goal.
The first World Cup final decided on penalties. Baggio put the last one over the bar.
Mbappé, at 19, became the second teenager to score in a World Cup final after Pelé.
Maradona's tournament. He set up Burruchaga for the winner with three minutes left.
A first league title in thirty years, wrapped up with seven games to spare.
The biggest winning margin in a European Championship final, and a third straight major title.
Played a year late because of the pandemic. Italy came from behind and won the shootout at Wembley.
England's first major final since 1966. Shaw scored inside two minutes and it finished in penalties.
Rank outsiders at 150-1 who beat the hosts twice, including in the final through a Charisteas header.
Arsenal played most of it with ten men after Lehmann was sent off, and led until the 76th minute.
The second all-Madrid final in three years, and again Atlético lost it on the night.
